lines: That was dull enough to be safe, at least.
I have seen careless steel with more sense than that.
Careful. Even steel looks softer than your manners right now.
I have seen broken weapons with better instincts than you.
You are a dull blade making a loud show of it.
I have seen cracked hilts with firmer purpose.
That idea has no edge and worse balance.
Your manners need tempering and a safer grip.
Even a rusted dagger knows when to stay sheathed.
You swing words like you never learned what they can hit.
I would not trust that opinion near a whetstone.
A chipped axe has cleaner intentions.
Your sense is loose in the handle.
That remark missed the target and damaged the floor.
You make a training blade look threatening.
I could sharpen a spoon before sharpening your point.
A scabbard has more restraint than you.
You are the reason weapons need rules.
That thought should have stayed in the forge.
Stand back. I know the sound trouble makes when it wants to be casual.
I have seen careless steel with more sense than that.
Careful. Even steel looks softer than your manners right now.
I have seen broken weapons with better instincts than you.
